word: The heaviness of being successful was replaced by the lightness of being a beginner again, less sure about everything.
meaning: 成功的沉重感被初學者的輕盈感所取代，對一切都不那麼確定了。
example: The burden of success lifted, and he felt free again as someone starting fresh.
hint:
中文解釋：精彩的對比——成功是「heaviness」（沉重），重新開始是「lightness」（輕盈），失去反而帶來解脫。
1) heaviness (n.): 沉重感；syn: burden; ant: lightness
2) beginner (n.): 初學者；syn: newcomer; ant: expert
pronunciation: Contrast: HEAV-i-ness of suc-CESS | re-PLACED by the LIGHT-ness | of be-ing a be-GIN-ner A-GAIN.

word: It freed me to enter one of the most creative periods of my life.
meaning: 這讓我得以進入人生中最具創造力的時期之一。
example: Being free from Apple allowed him to be more creative than ever before.
hint:
中文解釋：失去帶來自由，自由帶來創造力——被解雇反而是人生最豐收的時期的開端。
1) freed (v.): 解放、使自由；syn: liberated; ant: constrained
2) creative period (n.): 創意旺盛的時期；syn: productive phase; ant: stagnant period
pronunciation: Liberation: it FREED me | to EN-ter | one of the MOST cre-A-tive PE-ri-ods of my LIFE.

word: During the next five years, I started a company named NeXT, another company named Pixar, and fell in love with an amazing woman who would become my wife.
meaning: 在接下來的五年裡，我創辦了一家名為 NeXT 的公司，另一家名為皮克斯的公司，並且愛上了一位後來成為我妻子的了不起的女性。
example: In five years, he founded two major companies and found the woman he would marry.
hint:
中文解釋：人生最豐盛的五年——事業與愛情雙豐收，都是被 Apple 解雇後的成果。
1) NeXT (n.): Jobs 創辦的電腦公司（後被 Apple 收購）；syn: his new venture; ant: (n/a)
2) Pixar (n.): 動畫公司（代表作《玩具總動員》）；syn: animation studio; ant: (n/a)
pronunciation: Abundant: NEXT five YEARS | start-ed NEXT | a-NOTH-er com-pa-ny called PIX-ar | fell in LOVE.

word: Pixar went on to create the world's first computer-animated feature film, Toy Story, and is now the most successful animation studio in the world.
meaning: 皮克斯後來製作了世界上第一部電腦動畫長片《玩具總動員》，現在是全球最成功的動畫工作室。
example: Pixar produced the groundbreaking animated movie Toy Story and became a world leader in animation.
hint:
中文解釋：皮克斯的成就是「被解雇反而是福」的最具體證明之一。
1) computer-animated (adj.): 電腦動畫的；syn: CGI; ant: hand-drawn
2) feature film (n.): 長篇電影；syn: full-length movie; ant: short film
pronunciation: Historic: PIX-ar went ON | to CRE-ate | the FIRST com-pu-ter-an-i-MA-ted FEA-ture FILM | TOY STO-ry.

word: In a remarkable turn of events, Apple bought NeXT, and I returned to Apple.
meaning: 在令人驚嘆的事件轉折中，蘋果買下了 NeXT，而我重新回到了蘋果公司。
example: Unexpectedly, Apple purchased his company NeXT, which brought him back to Apple.
hint:
中文解釋：命運的驚人迴旋——當年被趕走，卻以另一種方式回歸，且帶著更強大的技術。
1) remarkable (adj.): 非凡的、令人驚嘆的；syn: extraordinary; ant: ordinary
2) turn of events (n.): 事情的轉折；syn: unexpected development; ant: expected outcome
pronunciation: Dramatic: in a re-MARK-a-ble TURN of e-VENTS | AP-ple BOUGHT NeXT | and I re-TURNED to AP-ple.

word: And the technology we developed at NeXT is at the heart of Apple's current renaissance.
meaning: 而我們在 NeXT 開發的技術，正是蘋果公司當今復興的核心所在。
example: The software built at NeXT became the foundation of Apple's later success.
hint:
中文解釋：NeXT 的技術（即 macOS 的前身）讓 Apple 得以重生——失去的道路繞了一大圈回來。
1) at the heart of (phr.): 在…的核心；syn: central to; ant: irrelevant to
2) renaissance (n.): 復興、重生；syn: revival; ant: decline
pronunciation: Core: the TECH-nol-o-gy at NEXT | at the HEART of AP-ple's | cur-rent REN-ais-sance.

word: And Laurene and I have a wonderful family together.
meaning: 而我和蘿瑞恩（Laurene）擁有一個美好的家庭。
example: He and his wife Laurene built a happy family life together.
hint:
中文解釋：在事業成就之外，點出家庭的溫暖——提醒聽眾人生的完整不只在事業。
1) wonderful (adj.): 美好的；syn: beautiful; ant: difficult
2) family (n.): 家庭；syn: household; ant: (n/a)
pronunciation: Warm: And LAU-rene and I | have a WON-der-ful FAM-i-ly | to-GETH-er.

word: I'm pretty sure none of this would have happened if I hadn't been fired from Apple.
meaning: 我非常確定，如果我當年沒有被蘋果解雇，這一切都不會發生。
example: He is confident that being fired was the key that unlocked all of his later success.
hint:
中文解釋：整段的關鍵結論——被解雇是一切後來成就的源頭，印證「壞事可以是好事」的人生哲學。
1) pretty sure (phr.): 非常確定；syn: quite certain; ant: not sure at all
2) if I hadn't been fired (phr.): 如果我沒有被解雇（假設）；syn: had I stayed; ant: since I was fired
pronunciation: Concluding: I'm PRET-ty SURE | NONE of this | would have HAP-pened | if I had-n't been FIRED.
